desc: Model 110 Predator delivers the customized fit required for consistent accuracy and it starts with AccuFit. Five comb riser sizes let you lock in the perfect cheek-to-stock weld for fast and consistent target acquisition and enhanced accuracy while four composite inserts establish your unique length-of-pull. Features: AccuFit System, Heavy Threaded Barrel, Realtree Max-1 Camo Stock, Two-piece Weaver Style Bases, Soft Grip Fore-end and Pistol Grip Surfaces.
